newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Cofar to move up to main stock market.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Cofar to move up to main stock market.

text.p: Controladora de Farmacias S.A. de C.V. (Cofar) plans to move its shares to the main Mexican Stock Exchange (Bolsa) from the local mid-size market on March 3, the Bolsa said Thursday in a statement.
The pharmaceutical company said the move was approved by the National Securities and Banking Commission last month.
Depending on the size of the company and the number of shares floating, Mexican equities are traded either on the full exchange or the mid-sized market.
